name: Lernvo — Knowledge Assurance Doctrine
description: Tentacle template: Lernvo ships per-department knowledge signals (acknowledgment coverage of approved procedures, quiz failure rate, overdue assignments, unanswered assistant questions, stale documents) into M-Core and turns knowledge pressure into training/documentation actions. Onboard a company by copying this framework under its tenant id — no head code changes.

signal_glossary.coverage_pct: 0..1 — share of active employees of the department who acknowledged the current version of every approved procedure
signal_glossary.quiz_fail_rate: 0..1 — failed / total quiz attempts in the department over the window
signal_glossary.overdue_ratio: 0..1 — overdue assignments / open assignments in the department
signal_glossary.unanswered_questions: count — assistant questions from the department with zero KB match over the window
signal_glossary.stale_docs: count — approved documents not re-approved for more than 180 days
signal_glossary.pending_reviews: count — knowledge items waiting for approval for more than 7 days
signal_glossary.headcount: count — active employees in the department

framing.fr: Moins de 70 % de l'équipe a validé les procédures en vigueur : relancer les retardataires et vérifier avec le manager.
framing.en: Less than 70% of the team acknowledged the current procedures: chase the laggards and check with the manager.

framing.fr: Taux d'échec élevé aux quiz : la procédure est probablement ambiguë ou mal expliquée — la réécrire ou ajouter un module.
framing.en: High quiz failure rate: the procedure is likely ambiguous or badly explained — rewrite it or add a module.

policies.name: Knowledge gap — employees ask what the KB does not answer

framing.fr: Plusieurs questions posées à l'assistant n'ont trouvé aucun article : documenter ce sujet dans la base de connaissances.
framing.en: Several assistant questions found no article: document this topic in the knowledge base.

policies.name: Overdue assignments — escalate to the manager

framing.fr: Plus de 30 % des formations assignées sont en retard : le manager doit arbitrer (charge, priorité, échéances).
framing.en: More than 30% of assigned trainings are overdue: the manager must arbitrate (workload, priority, deadlines).

framing.fr: Des documents approuvés n'ont pas été revus depuis plus de 6 mois : planifier une relecture et une ré-approbation.
framing.en: Approved documents have not been reviewed for over 6 months: schedule a review and re-approval.

framing.fr: Des contenus attendent une approbation depuis plus de 7 jours : les employés continuent d'appliquer l'ancienne version.
framing.en: Content has been waiting for approval for over 7 days: employees keep applying the old version.
